faq_heading: Port Moody commercial real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. Sale and lease listings.

Commercial property for sale in Port Moody: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. The search shows space for sale and for lease. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
Commercial and industrial areas in Port Moody

items.t: Port Moody has 443 hectares of industrial land (July 1, 2025), including Ioco (230 hectares) and St John’s / Barnett Highway (212 hectares). ([Metro Vancouver 2025 Industrial Lands Inventory](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-planning/Documents/mv-industrial-lands-inventory-summary-report-appendices-2025.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

A new business in a commercial space needs its building and fire inspections accepted before the licence is approved. ([City of Port Moody, business licences](https://www.portmoody.ca/business-development-and-planning/business-licences-and-permits/), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: What sold across the Lower Mainland

Commercial Edge does not break out Port Moody in the figures published on this site. Across the Lower Mainland, 285 commercial properties sold in the second quarter of 2026, worth $1,540.8M: 81 industrial, 56 land, 46 office, 82 retail and other, and 20 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
